title: dedicated: autoscale burst controls + improved fleet utilization reporting (v2)
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: customers on Dedicated want more predictable tail latency and cost control during traffic spikes while SRE/product want clearer fleet utilization signals. This PR implements: 1) a refined burst budget model for Dedicated autoscaler that separates short-lived burst capacity vs sustained autoscale capacity, 2) per-customer burst quotas configurable via the Dedicated tenant config + API, 3) a new utilization_reporting pipeline that emits per-pool 1m/5m/1h utilization and burst-consumption metrics to observability, 4) safety controls that limit burst concurrency per model-family and automatically throttle non-critical routes when budgets are exhausted. Changes are backwards-compatible by default: old configs are interpreted as unlimited burst=false. Includes migration path, rollout plan, and tests. Checklist: [x] design doc linked, [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests (canary), [x] telemetry dashboards updated, [x] migration script, [x] docs updated. Rollout: start with 10% of fleets in canary with fallback to current autoscaler; monitor burst_consumption and request latency for 24h before broader rollout.
